supply.label: FDV
supply.basis: Illustrative fully diluted value: recorded USD price multiplied by the archived total supply. Historical circulating supply is unverified.
supply.sourceNote: Total supply is retained only to reproduce the historical FDV illustration. Asset identity and token-specific source links are omitted.

peak.note: Highest observed post-entry candle high in the retrieved GMGN history. The time identifies its candle interval, not an exact trade time. All later events and the intervening adverse price path remain outside this endpoint comparison.

allTimeHigh.note: Highest daily high in the complete captured GMGN series from creation. This is a provider-scoped observed high, not independently established cross-venue ATH. Current GMGN ATH metadata matches.

coverage.note: One real daily candle for every UTC day from the creation date through the latest requested day; no interpolation. The last day is partial when marked incomplete. This verifies returned bucket coverage, not completeness across all venues or every historical trade.
